title: MedConnectPulseReceptionistIntent
description: Strict validation schema for GPT-4o-mini administrative receptionist intent extraction output in MedConnect Pulse.

intent.description: Primary operational intent derived from conversational speech/text.

language.description: Primary language of patient input (Hindi, Indian English, Tamil, Telugu).

urgency_level.description: Operational urgency level for triage. CRITICAL_EMERGENCY requires instant handover.

is_confirmed_by_patient.description: True only if the patient has explicitly verified and approved the specific doctor, date, and slot.

confidence.description: Model self-assessed extraction confidence score between 0.0 and 1.0.

name.description: Full name of the patient as stated.

phone.description: Standard 10-digit Indian phone number optionally prefixed with +91.

is_existing_patient.description: Whether the patient indicates prior registration at the hospital.

department.description: Suggested hospital department based strictly on non-clinical administrative routing.

preferred_doctor_id.description: UUID of configured hospital doctor if matched.

preferred_doctor_name.description: Name of the doctor matched from hospital directory.

preferred_date.description: Requested appointment date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

symptoms_summary.description: List of verbatim complaints or reasons stated by patient for administrative routing only.

primary_text.description: Rich text message presented on screen or in chat.

spoken_text.description: Concise, natural phonetically friendly script for Sarvam Bulbul TTS generation.

requires_followup.description: Whether conversational dialog must continue to collect missing fields.
